capabilities: : Search files using configured root paths and glob patterns
: Transform text into file card or link syntax
disambiguation: This plugin is specifically designed to handle files located outside the Obsidian vault.
intentEvidence: I design this plugin to make these files accessible within Obsidian across my multiple devices.
motivation: The author built it for personal use to make cloud-stored documents (like those on OneDrive) accessible within Obsidian across multiple devices.
problem: Users need a way to reference and view files stored in external cloud services or directories outside the Obsidian vault.
summary: External File Card displays information and provides links to files stored outside the Obsidian vault using custom code blocks and URIs.
